statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations
The patient has a known history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
CPT code 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring) was billed
The claim was denied with denial reason code CO-50
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry is clinically appropriate to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry is clinically appropriate to assess for ischemic changes in the context of established coronary artery disease
